notice.heading: About this demo
paragraphs: This is an independent technical demo built by Raj Purohith Arjun. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or reviewed by EnergyX, and it is not a redesign of the EnergyX website.
Nothing on this site is an offer to sell, or a solicitation of an offer to buy, any security.
Every figure comes from EnergyX public pages or from Raj's own measurements, and each one links to its source. None has been approved by EnergyX.

llms.title: EnergyX Trust Layer (unaffiliated demo)
llms.summary: Sourced facts about EnergyX, compiled by Raj Purohith Arjun as an interview demo. Not an official EnergyX communication. No figure here has been approved by EnergyX.
notes: Each fact states its basis: what the figure counts. "stated" means the source page says so; "inferred" means it does not, and the basis is this registry's reading.
Forward-looking figures are marked. They are plans or estimates EnergyX has published, not results. They are listed because they are published, not because they are expected to happen.
Only facts checked against their source are listed. This file is generated from the same registry as the pages on this site, so the two cannot disagree.

labels.details: Basis, other published figures and status

sameSubject.heading: Same subject, different measures
sameSubject.body: EnergyX publishes more than one figure for these subjects across its site and SEC filings. They are most likely all accurate and counting different things. Where a source page states what its figure counts, that basis is quoted here. Where it doesn't, the basis is inferred and marked as such — and that gap is what this registry exists to close.
